bug_semantics: OS command injection (CWE-78/CWE-77): a caller-supplied URL is interpolated unquoted into a youtube-dl/yt-dlp command string and executed with subprocess.run(..., shell=True). The current sink is ytdlp_download() in src/transcribe_anything/ytldp_download.py (cmd = f'yt-dlp --no-check-certificate -x {url} -o "out.%(ext)s"'). Reachable from fetch_audio() when url_or_file starts with http/ftp, then from the public transcribe() API and CLI. Shell metacharacters in the URL run as a separate OS command. Same mechanism as the original downloader: unquoted URL interpolation into a shell command.
flaw_origin: First write is 7247b8c3fbdcdb625ab42389b2cc0781383e5e1c (2021-05-08, subject 'adds code'), which created transcribe_anything/run.py with fetch_mono_16000_audio interpolating url_or_file into youtube-dl and running it with shell=True. Parent a7aa39feed35b757edf9ca1fc79f99f6296ced2f contains only .gitignore, LICENSE, and README.md; git cat-file -e PARENT:transcribe_anything/run.py fails. Later commits are carriers, refactors, or reverts, not origin: 460a1f07 moved the sink into audio.py; 7064a4f renamed youtube-dl to yt-dlp without changing interpolation; c250312/8292cc35/8c2cd98 rewrote a helper still interpolating url; 3deb502 extracted those lines into ytldp_download.py (parent already had def _ytdlp_download with the same cmd and shell=True). e9ae5f32 flipped shell=False while keeping the f-string; b4e5d23 restored shell=True. None of those first-wrote the vulnerable interpolation.

reasoning: The advisory describes a real command-injection sink, not a false positive. The BIC is the first public commit that wrote unquoted URL interpolation into a youtube-dl/yt-dlp shell command; later file moves and the 2025 shell=True restore are not first-writes. That BIC commit object has human authorship (zackees) and no AI trailers or bot identity, so the verdict is NOT_AI rather than AI_ROOT_CAUSE/AI_CODE_FLAWED. No security fix landed: HEAD and v4.1.0 still contain the injectable ytdlp_download sink, matching the still-open issue #137.
remaining_gap: Unpatched. No upstream fix SHA exists through HEAD ab1fe6ab3b4262ba5117c3c5a99a49ee36e771f3. Potential fix: pass an argv list to subprocess.run with shell=False (['yt-dlp','--no-check-certificate','-x',url,'-o','out.%(ext)s']) so the URL is not re-parsed by a shell, matching the sibling _convert_to_wav change in 33b9390e / PR #99; optionally allowlist http(s)/ftp via urllib.parse. Reference: https://github.com/zackees/transcribe-anything/issues/137.
